body: REDGARDEN commit b1bfd89. Founder live: 'still after 1 game in redgarden everything breaks.' Confirmed via matchmaker log: a genuine 20/20 lobby entered draft then died on the 60s no-progress timeout. Reproduced a bot-only 20/20 lobby to rule out a server bug -- completed cleanly every time, isolating it to the human's own pick. Root cause: net_send_pick()/arena_bot's send_pick() were single fire-and-forget UDP sends with zero retry (unlike net_connect which already retries), and net_picked latched to 1 on send not confirmation. A real external connection can drop that one packet; localhost bots never could. Fixed with a ~1s resend loop in both clients while stuck in draft. Verified via build.sh, build_arena.sh, test_arena.sh, test_10_bots.sh, and a local mingw cross-compile, all clean. Systemd services restarted with the fixed binaries. Closes BACKLOG S170-99.
title: Real cause of 'everything breaks after 1 game': pick-send had zero retry
